title: 95 lbs (42 kg) Bugenhagen rows for 12
summary: Clip of 95 lb (42 kg) 'Bugenhagen rows' for 12, set to music. Per the description, it is his name for a dumbbell row that mixes Kroc rows and Dorian rows without posting up, an idea he got from wrestler Eric Bugenhagen.

claims.claim: The 'Bugenhagen row' is a mix between Kroc rows and Dorian rows done without posting up (no supporting hand), named after Eric Bugenhagen, who recommends not posting up when rowing.

exercises.name: Bugenhagen row
cues: don't post up on a bench or hand
exercises.why: Kroc/Dorian row hybrid for back size
